Story

Community Origins

The Intune Assistant was born from a community idea to create a platform that provides assignment insights quickly. Developed by Sander Rozemuller - Microsoft Intune MVP - this tool started as a simple solution for the community's daily challenges.

Natural Evolution

Over time, the tool evolved into a comprehensive platform providing deep insights into Microsoft Intune environments. Companies approached me requesting custom extensions for their specific business workflows, leading to our enterprise offerings while keeping the core platform completely free.

Enterprise Partnership

ControlFlex - founded by Microsoft Intune MVPs Kenneth van Surksum and Sander Rozemuller - became the first enterprise partner, investing in the platform to enhance it for both community and enterprise users while enabling professional support at scale.
